results.title: Trying to read all user mailbox using graph apis - Microsoft Q&A
results.snippet: Microsoft Graph APIs works under delegated permissions scope. So, Mail.Read should be needed under delegated type permission to access the authenticated user's mailbox. Have you checked this requirement?

results.title: Microsoft Graph API Authentication Guide (2026) | ImRizwan
results.snippet: Microsoft Graph API authentication: app registration, OAuth flows, MSAL setup, and permissions — with working code examples for 2026.Example: A web app that reads the signed-in user's emails requires Mail.Read delegated permission. Application Permissions (Daemon/Service).

results.title: Mail.Read | Graph Permissions
results.snippet: Mail.Read is valid valid for both Microsoft accounts and work or school accounts. Merill's Note. For an app to access data in Microsoft Graph, the user or administrator must grant it the permissions it needs.

results.title: Granting OAuth2 Application Access for Microsoft Graph
results.snippet: Choose Microsoft Graph. Choose Application permissions (not Delegated). Search for and select Mail.Send. Click Add permissions. Step 4 — Grant Admin Consent. Application permissions don't activate on their own — an admin has to explicitly approve them.
